feature: A zoomed recording is ringed on the frame
summary: Pick a recording you have pushed in on and the canvas rings the frame, where the shot is, instead of outlining the magnified picture out on the empty canvas with a handle hanging off it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk.json.

try.do: Open the sample recording, pick it, and key Scale at 0:03 (Animate a property, Scale).
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the ruler at 0:05 and type 220 in Scale.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag the picture to frame a spot.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Look at the left edge of the frame: the ring sits on it and nothing hangs out on the empty canvas.
Click the ruler at 0:03: the clip wears its usual box and handles again.
At 0:05 type a title with T and pick it with V.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Does the ring on the frame tell you the recording is picked without making you look for it?
Is it right that a pushed-in clip offers no handles, so the push is changed with Scale and the framing by dragging the picture?
When you scrub from the wide shot into the push, does the box turning into a ring read as natural rather than as something switching off?
rough: The ring wears the app-wide picked outline (dashed blue) while the mock draws a solid accent ring (video-zoom-wt.html #frameRing); covered by a-picked-layer-wears-the-solid-accent-ring-the-m.
A click on the empty canvas just past the frame still keeps the zoomed recording picked, because its magnified picture reaches there; covered by a-click-on-the-empty-canvas-past-the-frame-lets.

The mock rings the clip with no handles at every step, the wide shot included; the app rings it only while pushed past the frame and keeps its box and handles at 100%. Put to you on decision decide-whether-a-picked-recording-at-its-own-siz-when-you-pick-a-recording-that-f.
